# Orkpad

> Orkpad is the open-source app for freelancers and small agencies. It replaces the broken Excel, the outdated Notion, and the WhatsApp reminders. Centralize clients, projects, time tracking, and billing in one self-hostable place.

## Product

Orkpad covers the full lifecycle of a freelance business: lead capture, sales pipeline (CRM), project and task management (Kanban), time tracking, agenda, invoicing, financial reports, and a client portal. Each workspace is isolated, and all data can be exported in JSON/CSV at any time.

## Open Source

- License: Apache-2.0
- Repository: https://github.com/ignaciobecher/orkpad
- Self-hostable: run it on your own infrastructure.
- Community-driven: issues, discussions, and contributions are welcome.

## Get Started

1. Clone the repository: `git clone https://github.com/ignaciobecher/orkpad.git`
2. Read the docs in the `/docs` folder.
3. Configure your environment and run the app locally.
4. Open an issue or submit a pull request.
